what: Firmware validation on the board. Every test enrollment was made by module_enroll.py from nine recorded idle reads of this boot (selection rows 0-8). module_serve.py (--backend replay, KDF c = 1) then tried one unlock per remaining recorded read: rows 9-19 are the other idle reads, rows 20-99 are 80 warmer reads of the same-boot sweep (57.0 to 66.4 C). The test enrollments were deleted; they are not enrollments of the board.
